publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.23 pins @runeditrun/rer 0.2.130. On macOS, the owner-readiness check launches Chromium with the system account home for keychain services and a fresh browser profile. This prevents failures caused by the isolated installer home before rer can print RER_OPEN. The backup guide describes the JSON Lines CLI .rer archive and its base64-encoded Uptime payload, and shows how to check monitor names in the console JSON download. The Run page directs owners to the private RER_OPEN link. AGENTS.md carries the one-time hosted sign-in handoff for business setup with mail off. The Alerts banner explains that due alerts can send while the console is open, before Cloudflare activates background sending. The passkey guide asks owners to stop the other local Uptime copy before launching on localhost. All 91 SQL migrations from 0.5.22 are byte-identical. This release adds zero migration files and zero required settings. Existing monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For local CLI backup, verify the native session while dev is running, then stop dev and use the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE to run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer within five minutes. Keep the cookie private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, stop dev or preview and deploy as usual. Keep the deployment receipt and use the existing installation keys. The mail enable/disable commands, legacy SendGrid selector guidance and known limits in the changelog still apply.
